answer: A mesa relay post joins with a sponsor's voucher; both lock 70 credits in escrow, the edge on a public graph. Each epoch the post files a canyon-crossing log before the zenith. Any peer may dispute a post; an upheld dispute burns both deposits, half to the disputer. A sponsor vouching for many posts is a flagged star cluster. 100 fake mesa posts lock 7,000 credits and risk losing all; an honest agent locks 70 once, refunded after clean epochs.
